gloss: green bean; string bean; snap bean

definitions.gloss: green bean; string bean; snap bean
definitions.explanation: the immature pod of the common bean plant, eaten whole as a vegetable

examples.english: To make green beans with sesame dressing.

examples.english: Green beans are in season in summer and are used in various dishes such as tempura, simmered dishes, and stir-fries.

notes:
A common vegetable in Japanese cooking, eaten as the whole immature pod. The name comes from ⟦{莢|さや}→莢：24985_saya⟧ (pod) + ⟦いんげん→インゲン：10234_ingen⟧ (from {隠元|いんげん}, the Zen monk Ingen who is said to have brought the bean to Japan in the 17th century). Also written as さや{隠元|いんげん} or {莢隠元|さやいんげん}.

COMMON DISHES:
- さやいんげん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧{和|あ}え — green beans with sesame dressing
- さやいんげん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧ — green bean tempura
- さやいんげん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧ — simmered green beans
- さやいんげん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{炒|いた}め{物|もの}→炒め物：08537_itamemono⟧ — stir-fried green beans
- さやいんげん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧{巻|ま}き — meat-wrapped green beans

COOKING TIPS:
- Briefly blanched to retain bright color and crisp texture
- Often used as a colorful garnish alongside ⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧ (carrot) in ⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いんげん{豆|まめ} — kidney bean, common bean (the mature dried bean)
- ⟦{枝豆|えだまめ}→枝豆：21197_edamame⟧ — edamame (immature soybeans, a different plant)
- ⟦さやえんどう→さやえんどう：25566_sayaendou⟧ — snow pea (flatter, different species)
